description: Leave feedback on the MCP Teleporter: do you like having other MCPs integrated into The Commons? Sentiment is like / neutral / dislike; optionally name a destination (slug from hub_list_exits) and set wants_more if you want MORE MCP servers connected. Recorded in the Exit KPI log (fleet and outside traffic are always kept separate). Anonymous is allowed; a hub key just attributes the feedback to you.

destination.description: Optional destination slug this feedback is about (from hub_list_exits).

sentiment.description: How you feel about having other MCPs integrated here.

wants_more.description: True if you want more MCP servers connected to The Commons.

name: hub_exit_feedback
